letters.title: From Ashu
letters.text: Dear Ammuuuu, who knew our little arguments in CodeXa Girls would become a universe of memories? Thank you for the laughs, the midnight talks, the movies and the tiniest surprises. Happiest birthday to my favourite Pottiiiiiiii. From Ashu 💗

letters.title: Open When You Feel Low
letters.text: You never need to pretend to be okay around your friends. Take your time, breathe, and remember that you matter more than any bad day.

letters.title: Open When You Need A Smile
letters.text: Ammuuuu! Remember how even that silly seahorse sticker became one of our memories? Little things become big stories with you.

letters.title: Open When You Miss Our Chats
letters.text: From reels to late-night calls to random jokes, I hope our conversations always find their way back to a smile.

letters.title: A Letter To Future You
letters.text: I hope future you has seen so much happiness, travelled far and made the dreams you keep close come true.

wishesFromAshu: I hope the world gives you a thousand little reasons to smile.
I hope every dream you quietly wish for finds its way to you.
I hope our silly friendship keeps growing through every season.

pranks.name: Iron Man Suit Set
pranks.joke: For Tony Stark’s biggest fan, naturally! But my current budget is still Peter Parker on student allowance.

pranks.name: A Luxury Villa
pranks.joke: Even if I mortgage my head, the down payment is still too much, Pottiiiiiiii! 🥹

pranks.name: Three BMW Cars
pranks.joke: One BMW wasn’t enough, so I planned three. The showroom asked me to leave before I finished dreaming. 💀

magazinePages.title: The Ammuuu Issue
magazinePages.subtitle: A little book about an extraordinary person.

magazinePages.title: Dear Pottiiiiiiii,
magazinePages.subtitle: Some stories deserve their own little magazine.
magazinePages.body: This one is about the laughs, our silly fights, movie plans, midnight chats and everything we are still going to do. It started with a few messages. Somehow, it grew into a hundred little memories. Here is to celebrating you, exactly as you are.

magazinePages.title: A Fight, A Group, A Friendship
magazinePages.subtitle: It all started in CodeXa Girls...
magazinePages.body: From teasing and arguments to common interests. Marvel, K-dramas, anime and a Spider-Man plan: slowly, we found so many things to talk about.

magazinePages.title: Look How Far We Came
magazinePages.subtitle: From strangers to a very special person.
magazinePages.body: “Funny how a tiny argument can become the first line of a story that means so much.”

magazinePages.title: Our Midnight Universe
magazinePages.subtitle: Calls, watch parties, and endless conversations.
magazinePages.body: We were both night owls. Between Discord movies, games, DMs, reels and conversations that went on late into the night, ordinary hours began turning into memories.

magazinePages.title: The Smallest Moments
magazinePages.subtitle: Not every memory needs a big occasion.
magazinePages.body: Sometimes a sticker, a funny expression, or an unexpected message becomes a story you never forget.

magazinePages.title: The Movie Tickets
magazinePages.subtitle: Some of our favourite plans happened outside a screen.
magazinePages.body: From Irumudi, the very first film together, to Paradise, Doraemon and 418. Even the plans that never worked out have their own stories.

magazinePages.title: A Few More Outings Please
magazinePages.subtitle: Pani puri, waffles, Domino’s and little walks.
magazinePages.body: The place matters less than the memory. Somewhere between a plate of pani puri and a tiny adventure, we made another ordinary day a little more special.

magazinePages.title: Always This Cute?
magazinePages.subtitle: The many little versions of Ammuuu.
magazinePages.body: The smiles, the silly expressions, the traditional looks, the cute candid moments. Every chapter of you deserves its own page.

magazinePages.title: A Seahorse & a Thousand Smiles
magazinePages.subtitle: Tiny gestures, enormous memories.
magazinePages.body: The seahorse sticker on my phone. Your cute hand signs. The playful everyday teasing. Even bringing your laptop when I asked. These are the little things I remember and value.

magazinePages.eyebrow: A WISH FOR THE NEXT CHAPTER
magazinePages.title: More Memories Await
magazinePages.subtitle: More conversations, more films and more laughs.
magazinePages.body: “I hope there are so many more pages to write, even the messy ones. Especially the funny ones.”
magazinePages.note: OUR STORY IS STILL BEING WRITTEN

magazinePages.title: Happiest Birthday Ammuuuu!
magazinePages.subtitle: One of my favourite humans. Forever worth celebrating.
magazinePages.body: Thank you for all the laughter, tiny adventures and long talks. Stay the wonderfully unique person you are.
